name: Hensel ENYCASE junction boxes
summary: Junction-box family with separate body, lid and cable-entry CAD components.
description: Build the layout from the exact box and terminal configuration. The manufacturer provides separate body and lid geometry; a lid-only model is not a complete enclosure.
Use the linked manufacturer CAD for dimensions and the exact selected configuration. The downloadable illustration here is original educational geometry, unitless and not to scale.
readingNotes: Cable-entry patterns and internal terminals differ across the family. Match the order code before detailing incoming cable routes.
An empty-box model does not confirm the terminal capacity of an assembled junction box.
drawingChecklist: Match the box code and terminal option.
Include the lid and locking components in the assembly.
Coordinate entry positions with cable bend space.
